text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHealthEven 10 Minutes of “Slow Running” Can Give Your Brain a BoostIt’s all in the head bobJCBy Jake Currie4:00 PM CDT on September 11, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleThere’s a growing pile of research showing exercise improves the human mind. While different studies using different methodologies may come to different conclusions, it’s become clear that at least some movement offers some cognitive and psychological benefits. So the question on every, shall we say, “movement-averse” person’s mind is: How little exercise can we get away with before we reap some of these rewards? Subscribe to skip adsFeatured VideoPowered By 10 James Webb Space Telescope Captures Stunning View Of Spiral Galaxy NGC 2283ShareNextStayAccording to a new study published in the journal Imaging Neuroscience, it’s actually very little. Read more: “Running Is Always Blind”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
